summary: conv-context-next preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (string-array rotation, `_0xNNNN` identifiers) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (arch-specific zip), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) obfuscated with a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift routine over a ~1500-entry mixed constant table) and mangled identifiers. The payload's contents are not human-readable and bear no relation to the package's advertised `conversation context manager` purpose. The alternate runtime (Bun) is fetched purely to execute the shipped opaque bundle — the executed bytes are attacker-controlled code shipped in the tarball rather than the package's advertised functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
